source.title: Some remarks concerning the Grothendieck Period Conjecture

accepted.question_text: Let Qbar be the algebraic closure of Q in C. Let X be a smooth projective variety over Qbar, and let X_C^an be the compact complex analytic manifold associated to X after base change to C. For an integer k, set H_Gr^{2k}(X,Q(k)) = H_dR^{2k}(X/Qbar) intersect H^{2k}(X_C^an,Q(k)) inside H^{2k}(X_C^an,C), where Q(k) = (2*pi*i)^k Q. Let cl_Gr^X: Z^k(X)_Q -> H_Gr^{2k}(X,Q(k)) be the Q-linear cycle-class map from codimension-k algebraic cycles with rational coefficients. Is cl_Gr^X surjective; equivalently, is every cohomology class that is both algebraic-de-Rham rational and Betti-rational with Tate twist Q(k) the class of a codimension-k algebraic cycle with rational coefficients?

Let X be a smooth projective variety over Qbar. Let Z_X be the Zariski closure of the comparison isomorphism between total algebraic de Rham cohomology H_dR^*(X/Qbar) and total Betti cohomology H_B^*(X,Q) after extension to C, and let Omega_mot_X be the motivic torsor of periods of X. Is Z_X equal to Omega_mot_X, so that the comparison isomorphism is dense in the motivic torsor of periods and all polynomial relations between periods of cohomology classes on self-products of X are induced by algebraic cycles on those self-products?

Let X be a smooth projective variety over Qbar. For all nonnegative self-products X^n and all integers j and k, must the Grothendieck cohomology group H_Gr^j(X^n,Q(k)) vanish unless j = 2k? Equivalently, outside the degree equal to twice the Tate twist, are there no de Rham-Betti classes on self-products that are simultaneously rational in the algebraic de Rham and Betti realizations?

Let X be a smooth quasi-projective variety over Qbar. Its de Rham-Betti cohomology groups H_dRB^k(X,Q(j)) have a canonical increasing weight filtration W_*. For any integers j and k, must all Grothendieck classes in H_dRB^k(X,Q(j)) lie in weight zero, in the precise sense that W_{-1} H_dRB^k(X,Q(j))_Gr = 0 and the natural injection W_0 H_dRB^k(X,Q(j))_Gr -> H_dRB^k(X,Q(j))_Gr is an isomorphism?

Let X be a smooth projective variety over Qbar, let k be a nonnegative integer, and let K be an algebraically closed field of finite transcendence degree over Q containing Qbar. For a class alpha in H_dR^{2k}(X_K/K), say alpha is absolute rational if it is rational relative to every embedding K -> C, and say alpha is absolute Hodge if it is absolute rational and belongs to the k-th Hodge filtration piece F^k H_dR^{2k}(X_K/K). Does every absolute rational class alpha necessarily have to be an absolute Hodge class?

For a smooth projective holomorphic symplectic variety over Qbar with second Betti number at least 4, the Kuga-Satake correspondence gives an absolute Hodge injective morphism from H^2(X_C^an,Q(1)) to H^2(A_C^an,Q(1)) for some abelian variety A over Qbar, and the source describes this correspondence as analytically defined through algebraic-group arguments on moduli spaces of holomorphic symplectic varieties and abelian varieties. Is this Kuga-Satake correspondence induced by an algebraic cycle?

evidence.quote: not known whether it is induced by an algebraic cycle
